install:
corepack enable
pnpm install
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
if [ -f .cursor/skills-mirror.tgz ]; then
  tar -xzf .cursor/skills-mirror.tgz --strip-components=1 -C "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
elif [ -f "$HOME/.cursor/skills-mirror.tgz" ]; then
  tar -xzf "$HOME/.cursor/skills-mirror.tgz" --strip-components=1 -C "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
else
  SRC="${CURSOR_SKILLS_MIRROR:-/cursor/stores/self/skills-mirror}"
  if [ ! -d "$SRC" ]; then SRC="/cursor/stores/bc-9644d405-17f4-415e-ba94-6cebedda0b97/skills-mirror"; fi
  if [ -d "$SRC" ]; then rsync -a "$SRC/" "$HOME/.cursor/skills/" || true; fi
fi
